StudioSnapshotSummary.title: StudioSnapshotSummary
StudioSnapshotSummary.description: Compact read-optimized metadata summarizing a saved Aether Tactile Studio snapshot.

palette.description: Active color palette mode at the time of snapshot creation.

baseFreqHz.description: Sub-160 Hz primary click tone frequency.

screenCount.description: Number of designed screens in the active screen map.

edgeCount.description: Number of navigation edges in the active screen map.

StudioSnapshotState.title: StudioSnapshotState
StudioSnapshotState.description: Complete native configuration state of Aether Tactile Studio.

depth.description: Elevation, glass blur, opacity, border radius, and specular rim settings.

synth.description: Acoustic synthesizer settings including sub-160 Hz click tone.

haptic.description: Haptic intensity, duration, material profile, Shore hardness, and clutch parameters.

engraving.description: Laser engraving symbol and optical backlight configuration.

animation.description: Spring motion physics and illumination preset configuration.

groupConfigs.description: Per-group material, pitch offset, glow color, and symbol overrides.

driverCalibration.description: Rotary CNC controller click and haptic detent calibration settings.

screenMap.description: Active application screen architecture map (nodes and directed edges).

StudioSnapshot.title: StudioSnapshot
StudioSnapshot.description: Immutable-core version history snapshot of the user's entire Aether Tactile Studio configuration.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the snapshot creator and sole owner.

note.description: Optional changelog note describing configuration adjustments.

versionTag.description: Semantic version tag for the snapshot (e.g. v1.0, v1.2).

isPinned.description: Whether this snapshot is pinned at the top of Version History.

summary.description: Compact summary metrics for timeline display.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the snapshot was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when snapshot metadata was last updated.

/studio_snapshots/{snapshotId}.description: Per-user studio configuration snapshots for the Dashboard Version History panel.
